description: injection_source.rs InjectionSource Display impl returns 'NntpPost', 'SmtpNewsgroups', etc. (PascalCase). The serde Serialize/Deserialize would produce snake_case if rename_all were applied. Log messages and audit records that format an InjectionSource via Display will show PascalCase while any serialized form would be snake_case. Pick one casing and be consistent; at minimum add a comment explaining the intentional divergence.
title: core: InjectionSource Display uses PascalCase strings instead of matching the serde snake_case rename
